notes.title: Steam’s Real-Time Strategy Fest conclusions
notes.content:
Steam’s Real-Time Strategy Fest conclusions

One month ago, we participated in Steam’s Real-Time Strategy Fest with a demo open to everyone.
Today, we’re excited to share our conclusions and discuss where we go from here.
Here’s a list of what we’ve already addressed:
[list]
[*] The Dynamic Frontline feature sparked a lot of interest in our community and was widely appreciated for the extra depth it brings to the battlefield. We’ve expanded it further and made it fully procedural across all our maps.
[*] We dug deep into our game’s code to finally fix the root cause of recent crashes and errors.
[*] Formation drag has been upgraded to feature two modes: line formation and box formation, both of which now stretch dynamically based on how far you drag.
[*] Drone carrier alternate mode: Players now have the option to either keep drones loitering around the Delta to expand vision or safekeep them and launch only when an attack is needed.
[*] Rally points can now be set for buildings under construction.
[*] Air prioritization has been added for units that can target both air and land.
[*] AI improvements:
-Retreats are now executed in the opposite direction of the enemy.
-Easier difficulties will take decisions much more slowly.
-The AI will now push more aggressively to finish off enemy bases.
[/list]
In the coming months, we’ll be focusing on providing a smoother online experience for our players:
[list]
[*] Player profiles tracking various stats
[*] Ladder system for competitive ranking
[*] Quickmatch for faster matchmaking
[/list]
Alongside these improvements, we’ll be completing our two remaining missions, marking the final steps toward our Early Access release—which, if everything goes smoothly, should happen this year.

Best regards,
Global Conflagration Development Team

notes.title: Steam Real-Time Strategy Fest
notes.content:
Global Conflagration is back online with another demo! Over the past four months, we've worked hard to meet the objectives we set in our last update.
While significant progress has been made on the campaign, it won’t be included in this demo—but rest assured, you’ll get to experience it all upon release!
Key Updates:
[list]
[*] Butcher’s Grip has received a complete facelift.
[*] Frogmen now disable enemy optics, passively activating this ability on their fifth shot. Meanwhile, mortars have been upgraded with fragmentation rounds that slow the enemy on every second salvo they fire.
[*] Infantry squad movement has been made more organic.
[*] All airplanes now have larger loitering radiuses and will properly attack nearby enemies.
[*] Smoke munitions have been added to Carpathia, replacing the Scan ability.
[*] A railgun upgrade has been introduced for EDU’s Highlanders as a late-game unit upgrade. This upgrade converts the artillery into a high-power gun that deals AOE damage in a line after a slight warm-up.
[*] Vanguard now has the option to upgrade their BUKs with Disrupting Technologies. This new upgrade allows them to spoof enemy commands for a brief period.
[*] Carpathia received an upgrade to their Delta, transforming it into a drone carrier. These drones significantly extend its range and drop deadly explosives directly on top of enemy units.
[*] Players now have the ability to host private lobbies.
[*] AI improvements: The AI has been given more attention and will now take more unpredictable routes while better maintaining its recruiting options.
[/list]
Introducing Our New Flagship Feature: 
[b]The Dynamic Frontline[/b]
This new system ties all checkpoints and their bounties into a self-monitoring biome that reacts to player behavior on the map. It calculates each player’s funds gained from checkpoints and their respective bounties, moving the highest bounty point towards the disadvantaged player, thus reflecting the realities happening on the battlefield.

Currently this system is only available on the Butcher's Grip map. As it matures it will be present on the rest of the maps.

Benefits of the Dynamic Frontline:
[olist]
[*] Minimizes the snowballing effects caused by checkpoints.
[*] Keeps the map fresh by exploring a different scenario every time
[*] Provides defensive players with more opportunities to make a comeback.
[*] Visually reflects the balance of power between players.
[/olist]

notes.title: Steam Festival Demo conclusions
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We’re excited to share our conclusions following the recent festival and  to give you a glimpse of our plans for the game. First and foremost, we want to extend a massive thank you to everyone who participated in the demo!  It was truly heartwarming to see that so many of you enjoyed what we’ve been working on and are excited about the game's upcoming release.
In our last update, we mentioned working on four key pillars for the game, and we’re happy to report that we’ve successfully tackled three of them so far. The AI has really shined, proving both competent and fun to play against, while our QoL additions were greatly appreciated by our players. The story has also advanced with the addition of a new mission, helping to familiarize players with the game’s mechanics while deepening the narrative.
[b]What about the Early Access release previously planned for this year?[/b]
Now, regarding the much-anticipated Early Access release that was initially scheduled for this year—we have some news. After careful consideration, we’ve made the difficult decision to delay the Early Access release to next year.
The reason for this delay is straightforward: while we've made significant progress, we simply don’t have enough time to fully execute on our vision in the remaining months of this year. Several factors, including the complexity of our AI system, mean that we need more time to refine the game to meet both our standards and player expectations.
Learning from recent RTS launches, we believe it’s in everyone’s best interest to take our time and launch something we’re truly proud of. Even though it will be in Early Access, we want to make sure it comes with all the essential features expected of an RTS game, along with enough content to keep players engaged and entertained.
What more is planned?
[list]
[*] We have yet to finish our last pillar which is: proper multiplayer support with player profiles, ladder and replays.
[*] Two more missions.
[*] 3 new unit variations with unique effects
[*] More unique unit abilities
[*] Skirmish AI improvements
[/list]
 
And based on very vocal feedback, we already did improve our Squad movement:
[url=https://i.imgur.com/V8CjgPI.mp4 ] imgur link [/url]

While we understand that this delay might be disappointing for some, we are confident that the extra development time will result in a much better game. 
Thank you again for your continued support and patience. We’ll keep you updated with our progress and look forward to sharing more details as we get closer to the new release window.
Stay tuned, and as always, we welcome your feedback!

Best regards,
Global Conflagration Development Team

notes.title: Global Conflagration progress update
notes.content:
Welcome back to our game! Today, we are excited to share the progress we have made since our last playtest. Over the past few weeks, we have achieved some major breakthroughs that we can now proudly discuss.

First and foremost, we have completed our game rewrite, and the [b]desyncs [/b]should now be a thing of the past. We have tested extensively, including a 3v3 match that lasted 40 minutes without a single desync. Our solution involved making the game more resistant to desyncs by resyncing key events, such as unit and building creation and destruction, as well as target-setting.

We have also upgraded the avoidance system so that units can now move out of the way, significantly reducing instances of units getting stuck.

We have replaced the Upkeep system with a system that refunds players resources for lost units. This change should have the same effect of countering snowballing without punishing the winning player, instead providing a helping hand to the losing player. The economy should now be less confusing and more predictable.
As for our four pillars we discussed last time here are some of the updates regarding each one 
[list]
[*] introduce more unique faction mechanics and push the asymmetry even further-  we have introduced a new set of specialized units for each faction. Carpathia has a slow-moving AOE chemical tank, Vanguard has an experimental laser tech upgrade that can disable units from far away. EDU will get a new Stealth tank but we have yet to implement stealth in the game. Carpathia also received tech routes for its buildings, allowing players to choose between increasing build times or unlocking advanced units. We also did some initial stat adjustments to the infantry but we will expand on that even more in the coming months.
[*] expand the base building aspect a bit more- we introduced the concept of power plants powering building production as well as adding late game defensive turrets for turtling players.
[*] Infantry rework is still pending- our biggest feature will be adding entrenched stance which will switch infantry armor type as well as providing better range and alternate weapons at the expense of their mobility
[*] more on map objectives- is still pending. Garrison-able and capturable buildings still needs to be implemented
[/list]
We also created a new map suited for 1v1 as well as 2v2. New decals have been added to our current maps as well as lighting adjustments and post proc effects We have overhauled all effects to increase their light values, resulting in flashier explosions and effects. 
I attached below a link to our google photos gallery folder that includes 4k screenshots of the new graphical upgrades:
https://photos.app.goo.gl/bnCQLefnKSruknv2A

Vanguard is now fully voiced and has it's own soundtrack.
We have added various upgrades and abilities and plan to expand on these even more.
Overall, the game is now much more enjoyable than before and a clear upgrade from our previous test. However, we are not finished yet. We are currently working on our first campaign mission, which will serve as an introduction to our universe and a tutorial for players to learn the new mechanics.
We are slowly but steadily making progress towards our [b]early access release[/b].

notes.title: Playtest is over, what is next?
notes.content:
Hello guys,

Sadly the time has arrived for us to take the playtest offline. I'ts been an amazing experience to share our game with all of you to the point where we even managed to organise a small tournament on our discord!
The feedback we received has really pushed our gameplay to the next level as well as fixing some flaws we initially had.  We believe that thanks to the community feedback our game is now in a better place than what it was 4 weeks ago.

The positive reactions confirmed our vision for the game and showed us that our intentions align with the what the players are suggesting.

Also adressing the big elefant in the room. We noticed some isolated desyncs happening to some players. Upon further investgation we think the best solution is to rewrite the core of our game to perform better. This will sadly slow down our efforts but in the end we will have a way better core for our game. As soon as the playtest is over this will be the first thing we will work on.

In the next iteration we will be focusing on expanding on 4 fronts:
[list]
[*] infantry rework - we really need to make the early fights more engaging and give infantry a more important role late game
[*] introduce more unique faction mechanics and push the asymetry even further
[*] expand the base building aspect a bit more
[*] more on map objectives 
[/list]
These along more QOL, unit abilities, upgrades and unique effects should elevate our game where we want it to be: a solid rts choice.
That's all for now, many thanks to the people who played and offered us feedback. Your help is much appreciated and we are looking forward to seeing you again on our next build!

notes.title: Public Playtest July launch
notes.content:
Welcome back commander,

We are back at it with a new playtest and a new big milestone for us.
Ton of progress has been made since last time and we are getting real close to our final vision for the game. These six months we have been really busy getting our third faction playable.
Let's look at a list of new mechanics that we have added for this playtest:
[list]
[*]Avoidance
[*]Veterancy
[*]Vanguard faction
[*]Helicopter movement rework
[*]Garrisonable transports
[*]Crane module
[*]AI Difficulties
[*]New music
[*]8 player map
[*]Starting units
[*]Updated tech trees
[*]Increased TTK for all units and reduced movement for units
[*]Unit selection circles
[*]Formation on destination by dragging click
[*]Squad rework
[*]Artillery Units that shoot are revealed
[*]And many more QOL fixes and adjustments
[/list]

So let's take a look at our new faction:
Vanguard will be a more defensive and less mobile faction with a lot of late game potential.
It can transport units in strategical position via it's Halo helicopter:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38361798/d57b425cf5816481675d5646482b06d41f30a4a5.png[/img]
It's scout unit can garrison units and have them fire through their fireports:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38361798/f3d258bb2489906b51971a4d46489fd4b4c2487d.png[/img]
They also have a t1 tank at their disposal, the legendary T-90
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38361798/b36218138cc89b700505c127e4668c4217641643.png[/img]
Iskander missiles will be used by Vanguard PMC to eliminate it's foes from huge distances.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38361798/1b6dbb3ae2b9befa1bc5480b080f7298a1631080.png[/img]
Fulcrum will be providing air support for Vanguard:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38361798/1ad8030f9918c812ff27fb068da9c3a78a0a5323.png[/img]
The playtest will last for 4 weeks.
Although the game is in a good state our job is not done yet, in the coming months we will be working on: buildings avoidance, units abilities, faction specific abilities, garrisonable buildings and capturable neutral buildings. 
With that being said please enjoy the build and offer your feedback on our discord:
https://discord.com/invite/GE2csnb
Have a great day!

notes.title: 2021 Playtest and our plans for the future
notes.content:
Happy Holidays everyone!
Finally pulled it together and got a playtest rolling. We are looking forward to hearing everyone's feedback and suggestions!
However the battle is not over. Next year we will be targeting four remaining CORE features that are still holding us down:
[list]
[*] Avoidance- Fan Favorite by miles. It's a feature no RTS can prosper without it. We have done partial work on it already but sadly it didn't get finished in time for the playtest.
[*] Veterancy - Who doesn't love their units getting promotions? It's coming boys and we've been missing it too
[*] Infantry
      -APC Transport 
      -Garrison Buildings
[*] New built structures- being avoided by units. Yes units phasing through buildings is not nice and it shall be fixed
[/list]
Along with a variety of QOL features and smaller mechanics this should bump our gameplay to a more enjoyable level.
People have voiced their opinions and we heard you guys. This coming year we will start working on our third faction: Vanguard PMC. We were skeptical at starting such a huge task so we ONLY planned it partially done for the campaign. But people made it clear.. there's no going forward without a double barreled Russian tank.
The coming year we will also be making our first steps towards a campaign. We got big plans...but we'll be doing baby steps and see if our grand plans are viable first. 
There are a lot more planned under the curtain. So expect more fun stuff from us!
Happy Holidays and see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Global Conflagration Expansion points and upkeep update
notes.content:
It has been a while since we've posted an update, however a lot of exciting stuff is happening behind the scenes! We have added tons of new features, mechanics and units and we are currently working on the AI. If everything goes well, we hope to do another playtest in a few months.

Now let's show some of the new stuff we got into Global Conflagration!
On each expansion point you can now deploy an expansion unit. 
[b]EDU Pioneer[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38361798/bc6ce86c9a28c4d567301469a441fe2ac2c9078e.png[/img]
[b]Carpathia Battlebull[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38361798/05f4492b9258121c3f184a9fab719646526efcc1.png[/img]
New infantry units:
EDU Bastion joins the battle equipped with Grenade MG for extra aoe dmg and a power suit to handle the extra weight and offer more protection!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38361798/b3e46f57f1c97945ab45566ea9e710278727a36c.png[/img]
Carpathia Huntsmen, equipped with anti-materiel rifles they excel at taking out light vehicles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38361798/5920c1d36ad1081f848a3bbedadc32d437a6ba0f.png[/img]
Carpathia also gets it's regular APC replaced with a tracked heavy APC. Badger offers more armor and extra punch at the price of speed and increased costs. Also Carpathia's Viscol has now been adjusted to deliver more RPGs with extra AOE at the expense of them not being guided and costing more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38361798/e015c3550c37074f6fc995a5a7c2bcd67e0aa73e.png[/img]

Let's talk expansions:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38361798/ca0529e293e1483d5ff1ddde7252e734b6e66d2d.png[/img]
There are currently 3 expansions in our game as seen above.
We prepared a quick explanation video of our system.

[previewyoutube=C7Xl38b3Pew;full][/previewyoutube]

All in all we also made a lot of progress on making Carpathia an unique faction and a lot more exiciting stuff are yet to be revealed about it.

Quality of life & miscellaneous
[list]
[*] Brand new rendering pipeline and improved lighting
[*] Tons of optimizations to make the game run even smoother
[*] New music and voice lines have been added to the game
[*] All units received a label to easier identify what unit is deployed on the battlefield
[*] Unit responsiveness has been improved
[*] Two new complete maps: 3v3 and 1v1 as seen in the new videos, with a bunch more incoming
[/list]

[url=https://i.imgur.com/2YHBmVk.mp4]Quick video showcasing the new unit labels[/url]

And of course balance.. we are continuously tweaking the balance in order to deliver a great and fun RTS experience. Here is some footage from our closed playtests showcasing our new map along some of the changes and additions mentioned above.
[previewyoutube=U23cls55yGs;full][/previewyoutube]

So what's next?
We are currently developing our skirmish AI which is a feature many of you requested in the last playtest. We are aware not everyone likes online matches so in order to have as many people enjoy our game we will from now on focus exclusively on AI. We will not have another playtest until it is done. 

Thank you all for your patience and support, We hope you enjoyed our update and we will do our best to deliver the next playtest this year with AI and loads of new fun stuff!
See you all on the battlefield!
